mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly lower in periods with triggered UNRATE increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the last two quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to reduced corporate earnings and investor confidence, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly lower in periods following a sustained GDPC1 decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the last month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods with triggered INDPRO increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the real GDP (GDPC1) is declining and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising simultaneously, it indicates a severe economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines and UNRATE rises concurrently
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly lower in periods with concurrent GDPC1 decline and UNRATE rise (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly lower in periods with high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the last three months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods following sustained PAYEMS increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% and retail sales (RSAFS) also decline over the last two months, it indicates a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly lower in periods with triggered HOUST and RSAFS declines (t-test p > 0.05).
